nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances; token balance ledger of StandardToken/ERC20Token
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger
uint256 public totalSupply; declared but only self-assigned in the constructor
string public name; token name set in the constructor
uint8 public decimals; token decimals set in the constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in the constructor
string public version = 'H1.0'; fixed token version string
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): debits msg.sender and credits _to using unchecked arithmetic
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves balances using the allowance of msg.sender
balanceOf(address _owner) constant: reads balances[_owner]
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant: reads allowed[_owner][_spender]
function () { throw; }: fallback that unconditionally reverts on plain ether/value transfers
ERC20Token() constructor: mints the whole supply to msg.sender and sets name/decimals/symbol; contains the no-op 'totalSupply = totalSupply'
approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _value, bytes _extraData): approves then performs a low-level external call to _spender
caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner and as recipient of the initial mint

low-level _spender.call(bytes4(sha3('receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)')), msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) executed after the allowance state update, forwarding control to an arbitrary address
balances[_to] += _value in transfer: unchecked addition that can overflow and wrap the recipient balance
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom: unchecked addition that can overflow and wrap the recipient balance
totalSupply = totalSupply; self-assignment in the constructor: leaves totalSupply at zero while balances[msg.sender] is minted, breaking supply accounting
